paragraphs.text: Meaning Judea, which was a province that is, a country which was in subjection.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: of the province that went up

paragraphs.text: Zerubbabel was chief captain and Joshua the high priest: but Nehemiah a man of great authority did not come now, but came after 64 years.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: This was not the Mordecai who was Esther's kinsman.
paragraphs.label: c
d
paragraphs.anchor: of the men of the people

paragraphs.text: Who were of the posterity of Hezekiah.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is inhabitants, for so this word (some) signifies when it is joined with the names of places.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Before he has declared the two tribes of Judah and Benjamin, and now comes to the tribe of Levi and begins at the priests.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: So called because they were given to the temple, to cut wood and bear water for the use of the sacrifices and came of the Gibeonites who were appointed to this use by Joshua, Jos 9:23.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Which came of them that Solomon had appointed for the work of the temple.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: He is mentioned in 2Sa 17:27,19:31 and because the priest's office was held in contempt these would have changed their estate by their name, and so by God's just judgment lost both the estimation of the world and the dignity of their office.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: This is a Chaldee name, and signifies him who has authority over others.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Which in our money amounts to 24,826 pounds, 13 shillings and 4 pence, valuing the french crown at 6 shillings and 4 pence for the dram is the eighth part of an ounce, and the ounce the eighth part of a mark.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: Which are called "mina" and contain 2 marks apiece, so 50,000 minas make 55,000 franks which in our money amounts to 69,666 pounds, 13 shillings and 4 pence so that the whole sum was 94,493 pounds, 6 shillings, and 8 pence.
